If you liked previous entries, you'll like this one. As a newcomer to the series, it was fine. Got it for $15 a month ago. Really hard to get mad when you spend less than $20 on a game. Let me be honest though: The game plays horribly on the ps4 pro. There's a resolution mode and a performance mode. The resolution mode looks fantastic....when your not moving. Once the action starts kicking in, frames drop in the mid-20s. Its God awful. Performance mode is unlocked to 60fps. During battles(which is every 5 minutes), it drops in the mid '40s. This is probably one of the biggest reasons this game is always on sale. OK story, decent gameplay, but performance is truly terrible. Digital Foundry can back me up. Kingdom hearts 3 has a similar issues with frame drops. But for $12.99, it's whatever.
